implementation: Whole-skin post-skinning deformation in GLSL and WGSL follows a lower-tread/riser/upper-tread contact path by arc length. Native raycasts measure the riser and bound both tread footprints. Finite skin thickness is retained outside the surfaces; normals are transformed using the deformation tangents. All model material variants participate, and local bounds expand only during active contact. The original three-phase native capsule motor remains authoritative.
rejected: Nearest-plane projection alone left a diagonal bridge; replaced it with the surface-following arc. An extra rigidbody-position gate could stall against a leaf and was removed; measured footprint bounds keep the skin on the tread instead.
